question: In which year was the Goa Inquisition formally established under the orders of the Portuguese Crown and Church?
explanation: The Goa Inquisition was established in 1560, under the direction of Cardinal Henrique, to police the religious orthodoxy of converts to Catholicism in Portuguese India.

question: Who among the following Jesuit missionaries was instrumental in requesting the Portuguese monarch John III to establish the Inquisition in Goa to check the heterodoxy of converts?
explanation: Saint Francis Xavier, one of the founders of the Society of Jesus (Jesuits), wrote a letter to King John III of Portugal in 1545 urging him to set up the Inquisition in Goa to preserve Catholic orthodoxy among new converts.
